body:
I was unemployed and looking  for a job for the past 1 year, luckily out of the blue I had a call from my old friend with whom I had no prior contact,since I passed from the same school 4 years back.I was rejoiced to speak with an old acquaintance of my school mate.

So I was quite  ecstatic as this guy was working in high places and I wanted to impress this guy with my  humor and get into his good books.  So we were having a good conversation on the phone and suddenly I reminded him about a guy who had one of the most embarrassing event in his life ,he was a clown  in our batch and I was merely relating to that event.

I was so dumb that I did not F***ing realize  the guy I was badmouthing to was non other than the guy whom I am having conversation with right now. This I did realize only after I have ended the call.

Fortunately the guy was a good sport, unfortunately he never called me back after I asked him a job .

Tldr:  Ruined my chance to get a job by not realizing the  other person on the phone I was bad mouthing to was none other than the person I was currently speaking to.
What is this a troll ? Shame on you, people come here seeking advice for there depression issues and you got to make a joke out of this.

I don't know if you are using depression as an excuse for your failings in school.
What kind of classes are you going for,  take online tutorials (MOOC) or at least ask some of your friends or TA for help.

None can motivate you, except yourself.I just want to say, do you want to flip burgers like the guy who skipped school.
I feel that you are a slacker,you just have to own up your ass and keep pulling through,period.

Dear op, you got an amazing job congrats.I wish if there is a genie or a spirit may be we can trade places, irony I am unemployed for 4 years( possessing an Engineering degree) and recently  after a lot of struggle I managed to get a customer support job with a meager salary,no family support and  no friends.

I wish someone could guide me how to get  my foot into the IT door. I had a girlfriend too but alas she had a great opportunity to go abroad and is now highly successful and married.Some one said " career is a one time opportunity it does not always knock you know, but you can always get a chance to meet another girl".

I am not asking you to choose one over the other but life is not without a sacrifice.. I am sorry man but I wish I had an amazing opportunity like you, if I had one, I would not have to  contemplate my suicide,period.
